verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack (logo, headline, CTA) on one axis, with good hierarchy and even vertical spacing for the banner. Its only flaws are minor: a bokeh dot sits close to the 'Light' descender, and the stack feels a little tight. B puts the logo, headline and CTA on three different left edges (about x=255, x=55 and x=100), so nothing lines up. Its CTA runs into a bokeh dot at 'Line', and the right half of the canvas is empty, so it looks arbitrary rather than designed.
